## Progress

- Open [PR #92](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/92): D-04 clinic overview at /front-desk/overview (`GET /v1/front-desk/overview`, audited, board access): every doctor with hours or visits today, visits per board state, running-late estimate (later of a late consultation start and the longest wait past its time; the same rule on the server and in the board's workload panel), next three patients with tokens, and the shared waiting room with wait timers; live through the board hub
- Reassign (`POST /v1/appointments/{id}/reassign`): a waiting visit (checked in, with nurse, ready) moves to another active doctor of the facility today for one of four listed reasons (no free text), under both doctor-day locks with a conditional update (of two racing desks one wins), its booked slot freed, history and outbox event kept, token kept, audited in the same transaction; "Check-in & queue" Full only; pushed to boards and TVs
- A doctor sees their own day first ("Your day"), read only, beside the per-doctor schedule view of MDV-P1-023; the board shows a "Doctor workload" panel (waiting count and delay in words, bar for the share); en/hi/ar, RTL, 44 px targets, axe clean; mutation-checked (12 server, 4 client)
- Follow-ups (recorded shortcuts, not ACs): the delay is estimated from board states and times until visit timings exist (P2); a reassigned waiting patient takes no slot in the new doctor's calendar

## Description

Clinic view showing each doctor's queue length, running delay and next patient, a shared waiting room list, and the ability to reassign a waiting patient to another doctor (with reason). Doctor workload panel on the board.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Overview lists every doctor working today with counts per state and current delay estimate.
- [ ] **AC2.** Reassigning a waiting patient moves the appointment to the other doctor's queue atomically and is audited.
- [ ] **AC3.** Doctors see their own schedule view in P1 (read-only) with their next patients.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
